links.comparator_used: Standard prompts under default settings (main 200-item evaluation) versus context-rich prompting on a 40-item supplementary set
links.effect: Context-rich prompting eliminated all errors across all three models (480 observations on 40 items), versus 94.0-99.0% accuracy in the main evaluation
links.tradeoff: Tested only on synthetic data; authors call it necessary but insufficient pending prospective validation on real patient data. The abstract does not describe the exact context content.
links.quote: Context-rich prompting eliminated all errors across all three models.

design_hint: context-rich prompting and repeated-trial consistency evaluation
